title: How to Turn Voice Memos Into Clean, Searchable Notes
facebook: Ever talk into your phone to remember something, but then can't find it later? Here's a simple trick: record a voice memo, paste the text into any AI assistant, and ask it to clean it up into searchable notes. Takes about a minute. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-turn-messy-voice-memos-into-clean-searchable-notes #productivity #aiforbeginners
